about: New San Van spawn points for the Locations > New San Vanelona menu. Each entry needs a title and either skate2_locator (a validated Location name in nsv_locators.json), transform (16 floats, rows; row 2 = facing, row 3 = position), or position [x, y, z] plus heading_degrees (facing = (sin h, 0, cos h)). description is the line shown under the spot in the menu (optional; a generic line otherwise). stream (optional, default BAM) names the Skate 2 world stream to load: the DLC maps installed by tools/build_skate2_dlc_maps.py (DLC_School, DLC_Community_Center, DLC_Parkade, DLC_MaloofMoneyCup, DLC_Rob_Fantasy_Plaza); their transforms are the maps' own start locators. Coordinates are Skate 2 world units, the same space as the freecam / Ctrl+F7 spawn. Rebuild with: python tools/build_nsv_dlc.py

spawns.title: Monster Clubhouse
spawns.description: A private park with energy-drink money behind it. Nobody's checking wristbands today.

spawns.title: Waterfront
spawns.description: Marble ledges, salty air and a whole bay waiting for your board. Land it or fetch it.

spawns.title: Waterfront Sea Wall
spawns.description: One long wall between you and the bay. Keep it clean or swim home.

spawns.title: Downtown East
spawns.description: Glass towers, polished granite and security guards with way too much free time.

spawns.title: Downtown West
spawns.description: Big sets and fat ledges between the high-rises. The suits never look up anyway.

spawns.title: Old Town
spawns.description: Cobblestones, brick banks and tourists standing right in the middle of your line.

spawns.title: Old Town City Hall
spawns.description: Nothing says civic pride like a boardslide down the front steps of City Hall.

spawns.title: Old Town Skate Plaza
spawns.description: A plaza built for skating on purpose. Enjoy it before somebody bolts a skate-stopper to it.

spawns.title: SoHo
spawns.description: Galleries, boutiques and pricey marble. Don't bail into anything with a price tag.

spawns.title: SoHo West
spawns.description: The arty end of SoHo, where half the sculptures are grindable and the rest will be soon.

spawns.title: The Rez: Midtown
spawns.description: A drained reservoir right in the middle of town. Nobody's filling it back up.

spawns.title: The Rez: Upper
spawns.description: Top of the Rez. Drop in and pump those banks until your legs quit.

spawns.title: The Stacks
spawns.description: Housing blocks stacked to the sky with a rail on every floor. Say hi to the neighbors.

spawns.title: Stacks Skatepark
spawns.description: A neighborhood park wedged between the towers. Locals only... unless you're good.

spawns.title: Slappy's
spawns.description: Slappy's shop. Grab some fresh grip, then go test it on the curbs out front.

spawns.title: Cougar Mountain Lower
spawns.description: Winding roads, big hills and no guardrails. Brakes are optional. Bruises aren't.

spawns.title: Mega Park
spawns.description: The mega ramp. Don't look down, don't back out, and don't wear your good jeans.

spawns.title: The Dam
spawns.description: They drained it just for you. Hundreds of feet of smooth concrete and one long way down.

spawns.title: Cougar Mountain Upper
spawns.description: Top of the mountain. Point it downhill and let gravity make the rest of the decisions.

spawns.title: Stadium
spawns.description: Floodlights, mega ramps and a crowd that lives for a good slam. Give 'em a show.

spawns.title: Oliver Elementary
spawns.description: The old schoolyard, back from the dead. No hall monitors, no detention, just the ledges you learned on.

spawns.title: Community Center
spawns.description: Where half the city learned to skate. The banks and ledges are right where you left them.

spawns.title: The Parkade
spawns.description: Start on the roof and bomb your way down, then cruise over to EMB, Hubba Hideout and the old Stadium.

spawns.title: Maloof Money Cup
spawns.description: The pros' contest course, all to yourself. No judges, no heats, no prize money. Just big ramps.

spawns.title: Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Plaza
spawns.description: Bobby D built a plaza with zero skate-stoppers and a spot around every corner. Go break it in.
